recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if CQI makes a new decision that eCQM set identifiers must be distinguishable from other Measure.identifier values.
issue_request: FHIR-17246 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 CQI Measure. The original request asked to change Measure.set from string to CodeableConcept or Identifier and expose it as a search parameter; the final resolution instead directed removal of Measure.set because the HQMF set identifier is already represented by Measure.identifier.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN 14046. The matching git-svn import commit e169985949ad77cfed6c6e86ee8036a90f98136e explicitly says GF#17246 removed Measure.set because identifier already supports the notion, and its patch removed the Measure.set row from the historical Measure spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition source defines Measure.identifier as 0..* Identifier and has no Measure.set element, while the current Measure search parameter bundle defines Measure-identifier with expression Measure.identifier. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive later discussion or minutes changing that conclusion.
reconciliation: No source edits were made. The current authoritative source already matches the published resolution and does not need a redundant set element or set-specific search parameter.
